title: [tenmin-range-reply-dust] parseFetchIdentityKey: characterization test for parsing fetch identity keys
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for parseFetchIdentityKey in src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.ts: fetch identity keys
- parseFetchIdentityKey("S1\u0000AAPL\u00002024-01-02\u00002024-01-05") is { securityId: "S1", symbol: "AAPL", fetchFrom: "2024-01-02", fetchTo: "2024-01-05" }
- parseFetchIdentityKey("a|b") is undefined
- parseFetchIdentityKey("") is undefined

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v2): Peace's task (source: peace). parseFetchIdentityKey has no test anywhere; this pins the NUL-separated four-part split and that malformed keys parse to undefined. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed.
